analysis.summary: 10 observations form 8 issues; 1 warrant configuration changes and 7 need review; 0 contextual groups.
limitations: Experimental LSTM scope: Developer-controlled local configurations only; 4 application families. Cookie persistence is a fixture correlation and does not establish real application purpose. No category qualifies for de-emphasis.. Frozen test: 30 examples across 1 families; no category is qualified for de-emphasis.

Scores describe controlled scenario labels, not exploit probability or cookie purpose. Findings, severities, assessments and evidence-based recommendations remain unchanged. Unknown, conflicting and unfamiliar input variants receive no score.
Structural snapshot order is not runtime execution order. Configuration observations are not proof of exploitation.
Only the existing eight checks are in scope; missing collection may hide additional issues.

findings.title: Potential session cookie lacks Secure
findings.description: A cookie with a session or authentication-like name lacks Secure. Its purpose is inferred from its name.
findings.recommendation: Use HTTPS and set Secure on authentication cookies. Confirm whether this cookie carries sensitive state.

findings.title: HTTP resource referenced by an HTTPS page
findings.description: An insecure resource URL was observed. A DOM reference alone does not establish whether the browser loaded, upgraded, or blocked it.
findings.recommendation: Replace the resource URL with HTTPS or remove the dependency.

findings.title: Potential session cookie lacks HttpOnly
findings.description: A potentially sensitive cookie is accessible to page JavaScript; its name is only a heuristic.
findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly on server-managed session cookies that do not need JavaScript access.

findings.title: Potential session cookie lacks HttpOnly
findings.description: A potentially sensitive cookie is accessible to page JavaScript; its name is only a heuristic.
findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly on server-managed session cookies that do not need JavaScript access.

findings.title: Cross-site session cookie needs review
findings.description: SameSite=None permits cross-site cookie use. This can be intentional; check CSRF defenses.
findings.recommendation: Prefer SameSite=Lax or Strict when compatible. For cross-site authentication, retain Secure and explicit CSRF protection.

findings.title: HSTS is missing or disabled
findings.description: The observed HTTPS response does not advertise a positive HSTS lifetime. This does not prove the site is absent from browser preload lists.
findings.recommendation: Serve a valid Strict-Transport-Security header with a positive max-age after verifying HTTPS coverage.

findings.title: Framing protection needs review
findings.description: No recognized restrictive frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options policy was observed. Whether framing is harmful depends on the page.
findings.recommendation: Set Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' or an explicit trusted allowlist; use SAMEORIGIN where appropriate.

findings.title: Script policy is missing or broad
findings.description: The response lacks a recognized restrictive script policy. This heuristic does not prove exploitable XSS and does not evaluate every CSP directive or meta policy.
findings.recommendation: Deploy a tested CSP using nonces or hashes and narrowly scoped script sources; review inline and eval requirements.

findings.title: Third-party script has no integrity attribute
findings.description: An external script has no SRI attribute. This is an inventory observation; other controls may be sufficient.
findings.recommendation: For static third-party scripts, consider a pinned version and Subresource Integrity. Review CSP and vendor trust.
